purpose: Freeze the first-week screen after a one-day implementation pilot and before downloading the remaining first-week aggTrades.

data.decision_interval: one completed UTC minute split into [0s,30s) and [30s,60s)
data.future_information_policy: Only completed aggregate trades and bars are used. Entry is the next minute open after a separate confirmation minute.

handoff_minute.first_half_signed_quote_flow: signed aggressive quote / total quote in [0s,30s)
handoff_minute.second_half_signed_quote_flow: signed aggressive quote / total quote in [30s,60s)
handoff_minute.flow_extreme: absolute half-minute flow is at or above its own trailing 180-minute 80th percentile, shifted one minute
handoff_minute.required_direction_change: first-half and second-half flow signs are opposite
handoff_minute.required_activity_transfer: second-half quote volume is at least first-half quote volume
handoff_minute.price_confirmation_inside_handoff_minute: minute body follows second-half flow and closes in the directional outer 30 percent of its range

confirmation_minute.required_body: body follows the second-half handoff direction
confirmation_minute.required_flow: full-minute aggressive flow follows the handoff direction
confirmation_minute.required_structure: close exceeds the handoff-minute high for longs or low for shorts
confirmation_minute.required_hold: confirmation minute does not retrace through the handoff-minute midpoint

trade.entry: market at the open of the minute after the confirmation minute
trade.stop: the two-minute sequence extreme plus 0.20 prior one-minute ATR beyond invalidation

sequential_policy: Do not inspect a second random week unless this entire first week passes without changing this lock.
